result.title: CoLaX: Context-Aware Local Explanations for Time Series Classification
result.summary: Post-hoc explanations for time series classifiers usually score local patterns, such as subsequences or shapelets, without regard to the rest of the sequence. Yet the same motif can carry different predictive meaning under different global temporal conditions, such as trends or regimes. We propose CoLaX, a context-aware post-hoc explanation framework that builds on shapelet-driven Shapley attribution and conditions local-pattern relevance on a learned representation of the full sequence. Global context acts at two levels: it produces sample-specific prototype weights and a temporally resolved signal that reweights the local activation map. The resulting context-conditioned segments are the players of a Shapley attribution game whose values come only from the frozen black-box classifier. On synthetic benchmarks where identical motifs change relevance across contexts, CoLaX improves AUPRC over the strongest baseline by 30\% on average. On real-world data, it achieves the highest AUPRC on ECG. Additional ablations indicate that the gains come from input-dependent conditioning rather than from additional learnable weights. CoLaX is therefore most useful when recurring local motifs change relevance across sequence-level contexts.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CoLaX，一个时间序列分类的事后解释框架：用全序列学习到的表示对局部 shapelet 相关性做条件化重加权，再以这些上下文相关片段为“玩家”做 Shapley 归因，取值仅来自冻结的黑盒分类器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“同一局部模式在不同全局上下文中意义不同”的设定与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、片段贡献分配相似，全局条件化重加权的做法可供核查是否可用于 latent 证据选取与归因；但对象是时间序列解释而非多模态推理状态，联系较远。
